arguments.command:
python - <<'PY'
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
from pathlib import Path
with sync_playwright() as p:
    browser = p.chromium.launch()
    page = browser.new_page(viewport={"width": 1000, "height": 850})
    errors = []
    page.on('pageerror', lambda error: errors.append(str(error)))
    page.goto(Path('index.html').resolve().as_uri())
    field = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='New todo', exact=True)
    field.fill('   ')
    field.press('Enter')
    assert page.locator('.todo').count() == 0
    for title in ['Buy groceries', 'Read a book', '<script>alert(1)</script>']:
        field.fill(title)
        field.press('Enter')
    assert page.locator('.todo').count() == 3
    page.locator('.todo input[type=checkbox]').first.check()
    assert page.locator('#remaining').inner_text() == '2 items left'
    page.get_by_role('link', name='Active', exact=True).click()
    assert page.locator('.todo').count() == 2
    page.get_by_role('link', name='Completed', exact=True).click()
    assert page.locator('.todo').count() == 1
    page.get_by_role('link', name='All', exact=True).click()
    page.locator('.todo label').nth(1).dblclick()
    page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Edit todo', exact=True).fill('Read two books')
    page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Edit todo', exact=True).press('Enter')
    assert page.locator('.todo label').nth(1).inner_text() == 'Read two books'
    page.locator('.todo label').nth(1).dblclick()
    page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Edit todo', exact=True).fill('Cancelled')
    page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Edit todo', exact=True).press('Escape')
    assert page.locator('.todo label').nth(1).inner_text() == 'Read two books'
    page.reload()
    assert page.locator('.todo').count() == 3
    assert page.locator('.todo.completed').count() == 1
    page.get_by_role('button', name='Clear completed', exact=True).click()
    assert page.locator('.todo').count() == 2
    page.get_by_role('button', name='Delete Read two books', exact=True).click()
    assert page.locator('.todo').count() == 1
    page.get_by_role('button', name='Mark all as complete', exact=True).click()
    assert page.locator('.todo.completed').count() == 1
    page.get_by_role('button', name='Mark all as active', exact=True).click()
    assert page.locator('.todo.completed').count() == 0
    page.set_viewport_size({'width': 375, 'height': 812})
    assert page.evaluate('document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth')
    assert not errors, errors
    browser.close()
print('Passed browser checks: add, whitespace, completion, filters, editing, cancel, persistence, clear, delete, toggle all, text safety, mobile layout.')
